description: This walk takes you along the River Witham in the Lincolnshire town of Grantham. The flat, paved riverside path is also suitable for cyclists. Starting on the eastern side of the town you pick up the trail on Saint Catherine's Road. From here you head north passing a riverside park and the historic Grantham Hall which is owned by the National Trust. The path continues north for just over a mile before finishing at a picturesque weir next to Harrowby Mill. You then return to the town on the same paths. You can continue your waterside walking in the area on the Grantham Canal .
